channel.title: Quick-Fire Bible Trivia
channel.description:
Short Bible trivia rounds for families, youth groups and car rides. Five questions per episode, a pause to answer out loud, then the answer.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Scrollway: Bible Study Game, an iPhone game that lets you play your way through the whole Bible. Scrollway: Bible Study Game on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
